name: github-universe
description: GitHub Multiverse is an online Decentraland-like dimension where devs from all platforms can work on interactive maps and explore the dimensions.

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm');let n=0;for(const f of ['server.js','web3/server.js','web3/client.js'].concat(fs.readdirSync('public').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js')).map(x=>'public/'+x))){if(f.startsWith('web3/client')||!fs.existsSync(f))continue;new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/^#!.*/,''),{filename:f});n++}for(const m of fs.readdirSync('public/maps').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/maps/'+m,'utf8'));n++}console.log('Syntax OK:',n,'files')"
